checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows the basic services fee as the service/overhead charge and no additional mandatory facilities, staff or handling fee was printed.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
The direct cremation options list a fiberboard container and an unfinished wood box, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description includes transportation and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required single-price items, not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase; the law-related sentences are the prescribed disclosure wording.
No text claims that a product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other printed wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown as hard to notice.
